name: Paul Chequer
title: Communication coach and performance specialist
bio_short: Communication coach and Guildhall-trained actor with more than 25 years' professional performance experience, including television credits for the BBC and Channel 4. Uses performance techniques to help executives build confidence and presence.
bio: Paul is a communication coach who draws on more than 25 years' experience as a professional actor to help executives build confidence, impact and presence. He trained at the Guildhall School of Music and Drama, one of the UK's leading conservatoires, and has television credits for the BBC and Channel 4. He runs Cleartrack Performance, through which he delivers leadership and communication skills coaching. His approach examines how people understand themselves as communicators and builds resilience and flexibility to handle any professional communication challenge, from boardroom presentations to media interviews.  Paul has worked with clients across financial services, technology, healthcare and government, helping senior leaders and teams develop stronger presentation skills, storytelling ability and audience engagement. His acting background gives him a distinctive perspective on voice, body language, presence and the dynamics of holding an audience's attention.  At ISOC, Paul delivers public speaking, presentation skills, media training and communication coaching programmes. He is particularly effective at helping technically accomplished professionals who struggle with the performance dimension of communication. He works with participants on voice projection, physical presence, narrative structure and the ability to think clearly and respond fluently under pressure. His approach is practical and supportive. Paul is based in the UK and trains in English.
